<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>解决问题 - 数学练习</title>
<script type="text/javascript" id="MathJax-script" async
  src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-mml-chtml.js">
</script>
<style>
  body {
    background: #e8e8e8;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 20px;
    font-family: "SimSun", "Microsoft YaHei", serif;
  }
  .page {
    background: #fff;
    width: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 30px 35px 50px 35px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    min-height: 950px;
    position: relative;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: #111;
  }
  .title {
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .title .faded {
    color: #999;
    font-weight: normal;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-left: 6px;
  }
  .question {
    margin-top: 14px;
  }
  .subquestion {
    margin-top: 10px;
    margin-left: 4px;
  }
  .work {
    color: #2b3a8f;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 4px 0 4px 60px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .work-inline {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-left: 40px;
  }
  .answer {
    color: #2b3a8f;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 4px 0 4px 40px;
  }
  .redcheck {
    color: #c0392b;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .fillblank {
    color: #2b3a8f;
    font-style: italic;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    padding: 0 6px;
  }
  .row3 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-top: 20px;
  }
  .fillcol {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .fillcol div {
    margin-top: 12px;
  }
  .placeholder {
    width: 130px;
    height: 130px;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #3a3a3a, #3a3a3a 3px, #2a2a2a 3px, #2a2a2a 6px);
    color: #ddd;
    font-size: 11px;
    text-align: center;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-left: 40px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    border: 1px solid #555;
  }
